name: Emily
title: Candle Square
description: A Candle Square maid who always carries cleaning tools and enforces strict combat cleaning. She suffers from severe forgetfulness, often blanking on important matters or even remembering them in reverse.
introduction:
The newest member of the Senior Maids of Candle Square.
As the maid in charge of cleaning at Candle Square, Emily always carries cleaning tools and rigorously trains the maids under her command in the art of <color=#2A80D8>combat cleaning</color>.

Despite her calm demeanor, she suffers from severe forgetfulness. As a result, Emily frequently forgets important matters or remembers them backward. This results in incidents that sometimes even exceed the scope of the plans Claire devised in anticipation of her forgetfulness.

Emily is sometimes found in the strangest places, acting suspiciously as if she were espionage. Whenever someone calls attention to her, she panics and rattles off absurd excuses. It seems to be an unspoken agreement among the Candle Square maids to politely pretend not to notice Emily in such moments.
